description: Use published or operational low/high impact thresholds. Scale baseline and future with the SAME thresholds; climate-stress change = future score - baseline score.
formula: Increasing risk: 100*clamp((x-onset)/(severe-onset),0,1); reverse for decreasing-risk variables.
notes: Preferred where thresholds are genuinely applicable.

description: Use one fixed Sabah-wide reference distribution pooled across baseline and agreed future climatologies.
use_when: No defensible transferable impact thresholds exist.
notes: Reference values are calculated once and versioned; never re-normalise by AOI or scenario.

description: Report the modelled impact/change directly in its native units or percent.
formula: No additional 0-100 score unless needed; preserve native impact metric.
use_when: A model already predicts impact (e.g., biomass/yield change).
notes: Avoid losing meaning through unnecessary normalization.

formula: Exposure = affected area / AOI area; optional 0-100 = percent exposed.
use_when: Inundation/flood susceptibility or binary/graded exposure layers.
notes: Do not mix exposure percentage with climate intensity unless explicitly defined.

use_when: Layer explains the result but would duplicate another scored indicator.
